text:
sami: Quick follow-up from the RCA: recurring inference latency spikes tied to KV-cache thrashing. We need clear ownership for immediate mitigation, medium-term root fix, and postmortem writeup. Prefer owners by COB Tue.
li: I'll pick up the immediate mitigation (rate-limit circuit + short-term cache TTL bump).
yousef: I can take the root-fix work around KV eviction logic and kernel configs.
nana: I'll be point for the writeup and customer comms (Accountable). Please tag me when tickets are created.
oncall-bot: Label added: postmortem-action | severity: high. Notifying current SRE rotation.
pm-bot: Added action item template to the thread. Reminder: include acceptance criteria and rollback plan.
sami: Thanks. Concrete asks: 1) temp mitigation deployed to canaries this week; 2) root-fix PR + perf benchmark in staging within 2 weeks; 3) postmortem doc published and customers notified within 10 days.
li: Created ticket REDWOOD-4899: temp-kv-ttl-and-rate-limiter 1https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-4899. ETA: canary deploy by 2026-04-01. Assigning to li, CC @oncall-bot.
yousef: Created REDWOOD-4900: kv-eviction-root-fix-and-kernel-tuning 1https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-4900. ETA: performance diff + draft PR by 2026-04-12.
nana: Created REDWOOD-4901: postmortem-writeup-and-customer-message 1https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-4901. I'll draft and loop in growth for external comms. ETA: 2026-04-05.
sami: RACI (quick):
```
Mitigation: R=Li, A=Sami, C=Oncall rotation, I=Yousef/Nana
Root fix: R=Yousef, A=Sami, C=Li, I=Oncall rotation
Writeup/comms: R=Nana, A=Sami, C=Eng Manager, I=Customer Success
```
li: I'll attach a short runbook to REDWOOD-4899 with rollback steps and smoke tests. Will mark the canary rollout as manual until we have telemetry confirming reduced P99.
yousef: For REDWOOD-4900, I'll include benchmarks: 1) mem pressure vs baseline, 2) request latency under synthetic load, 3) KV hit ratio. If kernel-level changes are risky, we will propose a phased quantization of the cache eviction window first.
nana: Adding the weekly remediation tracker spreadsheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RemediationTrack) to the tickets. Please update status column after each meeting.
sami: Let's hold a 30m sync tomorrow to triage blocker risks. Li/Yousef/Nana, 9:30 AM PT?
li: 9:30 works for me.
yousef: I can do that.
nana: I'll be there and will take notes for the postmortem doc.
oncall-bot: Scheduled incident sync: 2026-03-31T16:30:00Z. Added to participants' calendars.
sami: Closing checklist for each ticket: owner assigned, ETA, acceptance tests listed, rollback plan, runbook link, and PR template filled. If any of those are missing by EOD Friday, escalate to eng-managers.
li: Noted. I'll post a canary test report in REDWOOD-4899 after deployment.
yousef: Will open WIP PR and request perf review from infra-team once benchmarks are ready.
nana: I'll draft customer-facing language but will not send until Sami approves. Also will publish internal postmortem draft to the ops-docs repo.
sami: Thanks all. I'll update the main postmortem doc with the ticket links and RACI table, and we'll use the remediation tracker for status. Ping this thread if things slip beyond the ETA.
